---
title: Verify a change
---

**Status: demonstration.** This small skill proves the collection's authoring,
publication, and installation workflow. It is useful when preparing a change
handoff and deciding what evidence supports a completion claim.

## Setup

Install `verify-a-change` using [Installation](installation.qmd). There are no
supporting skills, external services, or language-specific tools to configure.
Your project supplies its own build, test, and inspection commands.

The authoritative instructions live in
[SKILL.md](https://github.com/butterlyn/engineering-skills/blob/main/skills/verify-a-change/SKILL.md).
The installed directory also contains an evidence template under `references/`.
Edit those files in `skills/verify-a-change/` when improving the procedure.

## Examples

Ask your agent: “Use verify-a-change to check this bug fix against the original
reproduction and tell me which acceptance criteria still lack evidence.”

For a documentation change: “Use verify-a-change to check the built pages and
installation files, then give me a compact handoff.”

Use the skill selection mechanism your agent supports. Explicitly naming the
skill and its installed path is a portable fallback when automatic selection
does not activate it.

## Limitations

This is an evidence-organizing workflow, not an exhaustive engineering library
or an automatic guarantee of correctness. The agent still needs access to the
project and tools that exercise the intended behavior. Installing a skill does
not grant additional permissions or prove behavioral compatibility.
